headline: Finds digital campaigning and communications roles at mission-driven organizations, ranked against my experience.
summary: Replace this with a plain-English summary of your experience: years of experience, roles held, the organizations you worked for, your strongest skills (with numbers where you can), tools you know, and the causes you care about. Paste from your resume. The more specific this is, the better the scoring.
prefs: Locations: <cities, remote?>. Levels: <e.g. coordinator to director>. Must-haves: <e.g. salary floor, mission areas>. Dealbreakers: <e.g. no corporate marketing, no relocation>. Organizations where I have the best odds: <e.g. small digital-first nonprofits>. BE EXPANSIVE: include junior and adjacent roles, scored honestly.
